issues.label: Irrigation System Failure

Pump failure from bearing wear, electrical faults, or well screen collapse

Drainage systems backing up and waterlogging fields when irrigation control valves fail open

Surface water quality fluctuating unpredictably with upstream runoff and discharge events
Conservation buffers overwhelmed by contaminated runoff volumes exceeding design capacity
